zh.title: 賽斯納獎狀商務機誤降美軍RAF Fairford（RAF）轟炸機基地
zh.summary: 一架賽斯納獎狀商務機偏離航線11英里；誤降美軍Fairford轟炸機基地
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 13 日的報導，一架賽斯納獎狀（Cessna Citation）商務噴射機偏離原定航線 11 英里，錯誤降落於美軍轟炸機基地 RAF Fairford（RAF）。
報導指出，該架賽斯納獎狀商務噴射機在飛行過程中發生令人不解的降落錯誤，導致機體最終降落並停靠於軍事基地。這起意外降落事件涉及商務噴射機進入軍用機場設施。
目前公開資訊並未披露該航班的起飛地、飛行計畫或造成導航偏離的具體原因。

en.title: Business Jet Lands at US Bomber Base RAF Fairford (RAF) by Mistake
en.summary: A Cessna Citation business jet landed by mistake at US bomber base RAF Fairford 11 miles off course.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 13, 2026, a Cessna Citation business jet landed by mistake at RAF Fairford (RAF), a facility that operates as a United States bomber base.

The aircraft ended up at the military airbase after flying 11 miles off course from its intended destination. The report described the incident as an unexpected landing error that resulted in the general aviation aircraft touching down at the military installation.
Specific details regarding the flight's origin, intended flight plan, or the precise causes behind the navigation deviation were not immediately made available in the initial reporting.
